thread:
Elena - Customer Success: @here escalated from AcmePayments — they report ~30% of inference calls returning 503s and a spike in client timeouts since 03:22 UTC. They pasted a bunch of traces and say it started after we rolled the latest runtime yesterday.
Ian - Support: Got the customer's logs, thanks. They show repeated 503s with upstream: unable to connect / worker restart. Customer is seeing retries but higher latency and some errors flagged as billing-affecting.
Maria - SRE: I'm seeing a correlated spike in upstream worker restarts in hosted-prod-gpu pool at 03:20-03:30 UTC. Node eviction followed by container restart loops on a subset of GPU hosts. Early sign is cuda driver errors in dmesg.
Ryan - Infra: Reproduced in logs: `nvidia-persistenced` shows GPU reset + kernel oops on tty. Attaching snippet:
```
[  3456.789012] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  3456.789045] audit: type=1701 msg=audit(1719456723.123:456): auid=4294967295
[  3456.789101] kernel: [UFW] NVRM: Xid (PCIe x16) 79, pid=0, Graphics error, reason 0x00000001
```
Vishal - Eng Runtime: The runtime logs from the infer-runner show a segfault in the attention kernel during KV cache growth. Backtrace hint:
```
infer-runner(+0x1a7f3) [0x55a1d2a07f3]
libc.so.6(__libc_start_main+0xf0) [0x7f1a2b1d20f0]
infer-runner(+0x2c4f9) [0x55a1d2b24f9]
```
Ian - Support: Customer says the errors are hitting their critical flows. They've asked for ETA and mitigation; flagged as P1 for CS engagement.
Maria - SRE: Quick triage — root cause looks like memory corruption on GPU leading to driver reset (Xid 79) which triggers container runtime to report 503 for in-flight requests. Affected hosts: gpu-host-12, gpu-host-15, gpu-host-18 in us-west-2a.
Ryan - Infra: I'm isolating those hosts in the LB pool, draining active connections. `kubectl cordon` + node drain in progress. Hold on new allocations to those nodes.
deploy-bot: Deployed infer-runtime@2026.03.14-hotfix to canary cluster at 03:45 UTC.
Vishal - Eng Runtime: Suggestion: roll back to previous kernel/driver combination for the hot pool while we investigate. Also we can enable soft-fallback to CPU-queued workers for customer routes to avoid 503s.
Elena - Customer Success: Customer asked to route their traffic away from the affected pool. Can we provide a per-customer routing rule ASAP? They have a high-availability requirement.
Ryan - Infra: Created a route override for AcmePayments to dedicated-hosted-non-gpu pool. that should start taking traffic within 2 min. Patch applied: `route:update acmepayments -> hosted-non-gpu-us-west-2`
Ian - Support: Confirmed with customer — after reroute they see a drop in 503s but some increased latency (expected). They're okay with the temporary change; want notification when GPU pool is stable.
Maria - SRE: Forensics steps: collected dmesg, infer-runner core files, and nvidia-smi logs. Uploading to /mnt/s3/forensics/2187654321-acmepay. Key artifacts:
- `/var/log/dmesg.218765` (GPU reset traces)
- `/var/crash/infer-runner.core.218765` (partial backtrace)
- `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` snapshots
Vishal - Eng Runtime: Reproduced a light repro on staging by forcing large KV growth patterns with batch_size=64 and sequence=4096; saw similar OOM/segfault with current kernel+driver. Patch candidate: bounds-check on KV resize + guard pages to avoid overrun. I'll open a PR and attach test harness.
Ian - Support: Customer billing question — because traffic was failing for ~8 minutes before reroute, will they be credited? CS will own the credit decision but want a short incident note and timeframe.
Elena - Customer Success: I'll prepare the credit request and attach request logs. For now we promised the customer a postmortem and ETA for fix.
Maria - SRE: Immediate mitigation summary:
- drained + cordoned 3 affected hosts
- rerouted AcmePayments to non-gpu pool
- blocked new allocations into affected instance family
- started kernel/driver rollback on canary nodes
Longer term:
- runtime guard rails for KV growth
- automated detection for Xid 79 -> auto drain
- expanded kernel/driver integration tests
Ryan - Infra: After rollback on canary, we ran the staging KV stress test; canary passed for 30m. Starting gradual rollout to affected pool with careful canarying.
Vishal - Eng Runtime: PR #3421 opened: `runtime: bounds-check kv-resize + guard-page`. Testcases included in CI. Requesting fast track review.
Ian - Support: Customer updated that errors dropped to <1% after reroute. They're requesting a notify when original routing back to GPU pool occurs.
Elena - Customer Success: Noted. We'll notify once SRE confirms stability and after the release is fully rolled out.
Maria - SRE: Logging followup — we'll publish an incident summary (internal) and a customer-safe postmortem. Tagging this P1 mitigated; continuing monitoring for 24h.
Elena - Customer Success: Thanks team — keeping AcmePayments in the loop. I'll post calm update to customer channel with timeline and next steps.
Vishal - Eng Runtime: Follow-up items assigned; I'll run extended rolling tests and coordinate with drivers team on ECC/firmware oddities.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout to gpu-hosts completed at 04:20 UTC (30%); observability shows no new Xid 79 on those hosts for 40m.
Maria - SRE: Closing active P1; marking incident as mitigated. Will file full incident report in postmortems/ with RCA and timeline.
Elena - Customer Success: Sending a short apology and credit outline to AcmePayments now.
